after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Name, section and email rows, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            name = student.display_name
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {name}")
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda item: item.display_name
    )
    name_width = max(
        len(item.display_name) for item in ordered
    )
    section_width = max(
        len(item.section) for item in ordered
    )
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_width}}  "
        f"{item.section:<{section_width}}  {item.email}"
        for item in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows

THISTLE = ("Thistle", "Bram", "A", "bram@example.edu")
VARROW = ("Varrow", "Ines", "B", "ines@example.edu")


# ---
def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    return Student("0", last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_display_name(self):
        students = [
            make_student(*VARROW),
            make_student(*THISTLE)
        ]
        rows = contact_rows(students)
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Thistle, Bram"))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Varrow, Ines"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        students = [
            make_student(*THISTLE),
            make_student(*VARROW)
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            contact_rows(students),
            [
                "Thistle, Bram  A  bram@example.edu",
                "Varrow, Ines   B  ines@example.edu"
            ]
        )

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        student = make_student("Thistle", "Bram", "A", None)
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([student])
        message = str(caught.exception)
        self.assertIn("Thistle, Bram", message)
